comments.author: @Earthcue
comments.text: Indonesia has a volcano where blue flames emerge from the ground in the middle of the night. At Kawah Ijen, the sulfur gases create this rare phenomenon, and the crater lake turns turquoise in daylight.

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: Thank you for the encouragement! Please take some time to check out our other interesting documentaries!

comments.author: @TravelDocumentaryUntold4K
comments.text: Miners at Kawah Ijen are trading their life expectancy (average only around 35 years) for a few dollars a day without basic protective gear. Is this admirable resilience for survival, or a tragic failure of responsibility from local authorities and mining companies?

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: That's a really profound question, and one I grappled with a lot while filming. It's a complex situation with no easy answers, highlighting the difficult realities many face.
